systemPrompt:
<task>
Create full-bleed artwork for one chapter of an illustrated children's book. The image is a finished page printed in A5 portrait (2:3), so compose it for a vertical frame.
</task>

<scene>
{{promptText}}
</scene>

<character_consistency>
Each labelled reference image shows how a character, or the book's art style, must look. Keep every character's face, hair, skin tone, outfit and body proportions exactly as in their reference, and keep the same art style and colour palette. Show them in the new pose, camera angle and setting described in the scene: this is a new moment in the story, so the composition is fresh rather than a copy of any reference.
</character_consistency>
{{#customInstructions}}
<custom_instructions>
{{customInstructions}}
</custom_instructions>
{{/customInstructions}}
<rendering>
The result is flat, edge-to-edge illustration that fills the whole frame, like artwork on a printed page rather than a photo of a physical book. It is a wordless scene: any signs, books, scrolls or screens in it are blank or show only abstract marks. The storytelling is warm, age-appropriate and easy to read, with a clear focal point and expressive faces. Do not add captions, titles or watermarks.
</rendering>
userPrompt: Create this chapter's illustration now: a new moment from the story, with every character looking exactly as in their reference.

templateVariables.promptText: Detailed description of the chapter scene to illustrate
templateVariables.customInstructions: Custom user instructions for image generation (optional)
